title: Backyard Movie Night
description: Outdoor projector, popcorn bar, blankets, and a vote between a summer comedy or a nostalgic adventure movie.
transportationNotes: Street parking is easiest on Pine Street. Bring a hoodie after sunset.
imagePrompt: A cozy backyard summer movie night with a projector screen, string lights, popcorn bowls, picnic blankets, and warm evening colors.
notes: Need one more extension cord and a backup indoor plan if it rains.

title: Penn & Teller Show
description: A road trip to see Penn & Teller, with dinner before the show and a late drive home unless people want to stay overnight.
transportationNotes: Alex can drive four people. Check whether anyone wants to split a hotel room.
imagePrompt: A vibrant magic show poster style image with red theatre curtains, stage lights, playing cards, and a summery road trip mood.
notes: Pick seats before prices jump. Confirm who is okay with the late return drive.

title: Saturday Beach Day
description: Swim, volleyball, frisbee, and a cooler full of drinks. Casual drop-in day with a shaded blanket zone.
transportationNotes: Transit recommended. If driving, arrive early for parking.
imagePrompt: A bright beach day with friends, colorful towels, volleyball, a picnic cooler, sunglasses, and sparkling lake water.
notes: Priya is bringing sunscreen and cups. Someone should bring a portable speaker.

title: Cottage Weekend
description: Two nights by the lake with swimming, board games, campfire dinners, and an early Sunday cleanup.
transportationNotes: Two cars needed. Pack light so there is room for groceries and sleeping bags.
costLabel: About $120 each for food, gas, and supplies
imagePrompt: A colorful lakeside cottage weekend scene with a canoe, dock, campfire, string lights, and friends relaxing at sunset.
notes: Still need meal assignments and a final grocery list.

title: Summer Dinner Night
description: Patio dinner, spritzes, and a shared-table reservation for the group before people scatter for August trips.
transportationNotes: Short walk from Bathurst streetcar. Reservation is under Nora.
imagePrompt: A polished summer patio dinner scene with colorful plates, citrus drinks, hanging plants, and warm golden hour light.
notes: Confirm dietary restrictions before the reservation reminder.

title: Outdoor Concert at the Park
description: Find a free outdoor concert or movie screening and make it a picnic night with folding chairs and takeout.
transportationNotes: Likely transit or bike. Exact event depends on the city schedule.
imagePrompt: A lively outdoor summer concert picnic in a city park with blankets, folding chairs, food containers, and colorful stage lights.
notes: Look up city programming once the late-summer listings are posted.

title: Skydiving Adventure
description: A possible bucket-list tandem jump if enough people are in. Need to compare prices, weather policies, and nerves.
transportationNotes: Would need one car and a full-day weather window.
imagePrompt: A bold skydiving themed summer image with a bright blue sky, parachutes, clouds, and a playful adventure poster feel.
notes: Check deposit rules and whether video packages are worth it.

title: Farmers Market Brunch Walk
description: Coffee, pastries, market browsing, and a short ravine walk if the weather is good.
transportationNotes: Shuttle or rideshare may be easiest depending on turnout.
imagePrompt: A cheerful farmers market brunch scene with baskets of fruit, iced coffee, pastries, sun hats, and leafy ravine paths.
notes: Pick a date after checking who is away in July.
